lines.text: Two important people share the lines in this house. The Queen rules the high floor. The King rules the low one.
Each of them has a sign at the start of their floor.
And mine is the bass clef
A true story from music history.
About a thousand years ago, a monk named Guido wanted his singers to learn songs faster. So he drew lines, and put each note either on a line or in a space between.
Clefs began life as plain letters written at the start of a line: F and C first, then G a little later. Over the years, the letters curled into the signs you see today.
Up the stairs is high, down the stairs is low. The clef tells you which floor.
